operation: Upper R78 main and isolated supply conversion
notes: Main U3 is R-78K3.3-1.0 powered by protected +12V_LOGIC on right stack pins3/4.
Isolated U5 is R-78K3.3-0.5 powered by +5V_ISO; ground domains remain separate.
C3/C4 output MLCCs moved to B.Cu at unchanged XY to clear maximum module body; no via in their pads.
5V remains on left stack pins3/4 for TMR-1-0511.
Power routing uses normal0.2mm clearance, standard0.8/0.3mm vias,45/90-degree segments; new power routes simplified to remove grid jogs.
